title: New-host staging build
summary: The staging build sequence is defined and the sanitized artifact is ready, but the target host does not yet exist.
evidence: The sanitized database has passed integrity and privacy checks.
The build sequence covers Node 20, process supervision, isolated runtimes, canonical side indexes, and launch testing.
Builder access is constrained by branch, operating-system account, runtime, and read-only database copy.
limitations: No staging-host deployment or builder access is claimed until T-024 completes and host verification passes.
